scope: Development comparison on already exposed PRMBench/ProcessBench population; not untouched confirmation.
question: Do the four registered candidate methods localize annotated PRM errors and ProcessBench first errors differently from the supervised PRM and the frozen Mind the Gap reproduction?

candidates.source: Monday candidate panel; HEM within-group weights, MoM between groups, channels_cell input.
Monday candidate panel; mean within groups, MoM between groups, channels_cell input.
Monday candidate panel; mean within groups, MoM between groups, groups_answer input.
Prop 2.4 only plus MoM; groups_answer input, saved score arrays from 2026-10-05 TCI run.

population: All 8 banks (B13/B16, B20/B23, B32/B35, B51/B54), PRMBench and all 8 ProcessBench cells; source-question groups retained for paired bootstrap.

top_k.status: Fixed diagnostic rows; top-2 is post hoc and will be labelled.

f11_prm.categories: Use the frozen PRM metadata error category field; retain the broader classification field as an additional label.
f11_prm.candidate_metrics: Per category and bank, report within-answer AUC and PRMScore for each decision rule and top-1/2/3.
f11_prm.supervised_prm: Use frozen labels==0 as PRM flags and negative reward as its continuous error score; report native and top-1/2/3.
f11_prm.overlap: On gold error steps, report both, only candidate, only supervised PRM, neither; candidate rules and top-k are separate rows.
f11_prm.error_distribution: Report answers by count of full PRMBench annotated errors; no analogous full-error count for ProcessBench.

f12_processbench.mind_the_gap: Frozen teacher-forced Mind the Gap reproduction, Shannon / paper EMA span5 / later-token attribution / top5 drop mean / native argmax; not paper headline scores.
f12_processbench.metrics: By first-error-position quartile and answer-length bin, report candidate argmax hit, first flagged step hit, and MTG native argmax hit; report early/late/no-flag misses and clean-answer flags.
f12_processbench.mtg_clean: MTG argmax always selects a step; it has no abstention/clean-answer rule.

primary_comparisons: All six paired candidate-vs-candidate contrasts under the same decision rule, plus candidate argmax vs MTG native argmax. Top-1/2/3 rows are descriptive diagnostics without separate inferential selection.

statistics.pairing: Shared source-group resampling across banks, candidates, decision rules, and comparators within benchmark.
statistics.intervals: Two-sided percentile 95% intervals; descriptive for this competitor breakdown, no winner selection or multiplicity-based claim.

validation: Population IDs/offsets equal for saved scores and frozen population.
Recompute HEM_MOM_cc, MEAN_MOM_cc, MEAN_MOM_ga metrics and require parity with candidate panel <=1e-12.
Recompute TCI_ONLY_ga metrics and require parity with saved Stage 2 metrics <=1e-12.
Mind the Gap hash, shape, offsets and PRM metadata label alignment must pass.
Any incomplete cell, hash mismatch or metric mismatch stops the run; no fallback or partial winner.
inputs: INPUT_MANIFEST.json pins all score arrays, frozen population, PRM metadata, source manifests, answer features, and Mind the Gap comparator.
storage: Use existing scores. Expected outputs below 200 MB; stop if measured projection exceeds 200 MB.
